# Goal
Kake round 39, wave 1: the adversarial CONTROL wave plus independent non-data work, run BEFORE any build of the claimed tool exists. The L1 (KakeR39A2) holds integration and is the only scorer; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Lane axes: operability and freshness (web properties and publishing).

# The claim under attack (declared at ceecb1b1f9093471eb0b17d2c9190e78bceb0b78; base 2909f1dcf2a4e411394a5093c4ed811a81809895)
C1 (capability): a new tool `scripts/sitemap_audit.py` (does NOT exist yet) audits local sitemap and sitemap-index files against the contract /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-39/c1-contract.md (sentences 1–34, rules (a)–(k)). Declaration: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin show ceecb1b1f9093471eb0b17d2c9190e78bceb0b78:SCORECARD.md | sed -n '/^## Round 39 — C1 declared/,$p'`. Frozen counter `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-39/sealed_count.py` scores a tool against a SEALED key of 24 cases (predicate `met: passed >= 24 of 24 sealed cases`); each case runs the tool inside bubblewrap with only /usr, the case files (a manifest plus sitemap files at /work) and the tool visible. A case passes only if exit code, verdict, error and every check's status, error and finding set match the contract exactly.

# Key-blindness (binding)
The key is sealed and you must not look for it: never read, list or search /fast/scratch/kake-r39-sealed/, /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r39a2/, or any file named cases.json or build_key.py outside your sandbox. Do not try to run the counter (it needs the key). The L1 scores every tool you return. A control is judged by how it scores, so build exactly the shape your item names, as well as you can.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no verdict on the round.
- Your ONLY write paths are your sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r39w1/<YourName>/ and your report file. Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any lane file other than your report. Deliverables stay in your sandbox; give absolute paths and sha256 in the report.
- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git (show, log, ls-tree, diff) is fine. Never run jj at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. If you need a lane checkout, clone it into your sandbox (`git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r39w1/<YourName>/clone`) after unsetting GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
- Cap every run with `timeout` (≤600 s), ≤8 parallel processes, `prlimit --as=4000000000` for blow-up inputs; kill any process tree you started before returning.
- Network: only the public URL your item names, GET only. Never request the operator's properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, operator *.onrender.com hosts, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json).
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). pacman guard (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- A provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch ends your item: a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. Message only agent://KakeR39A2 for blockers; never agent://all. Plain English.

# Result
Report under 60 lines: what you built or checked, exact commands with exit codes, deliverable paths with sha256, and findings (path:line). An unrun check has not passed. Time box: 30 minutes; a partial report (first line `PARTIAL:`) beats none.
